content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen is solid: photo, eyebrow, headline and intro read in order, but the two CTAs are weak underlined links and the page below repeats the brand claim twice more.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero works with the card overlapping the photo, but the services grid leaves a dead right column and the replacement-car section has a wide empty gap beside the photo.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Make the hero call-to-action a real button on phone (like on desktop) and drop the 'Kako do nas' link there since it repeats in the contact section.","Cut repetition: the four-brand claim appears in the hero, the 2012 block and the closing CTA; merge the 2012 block into the hero or contact section.","Balance the desktop services grid (3 columns or make the odd item span) and tighten the empty space right of the mechanic photo and under the contact row."],"blockers":[]}
